from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class CompanyAssetReport(BaseModel):
    """A company's financial report data regarding total current assets."""
    company_name: str | None = Field(description="Name of the company as reported")
    metric_label: str | None = Field(description="The specific line item label for the assets (e.g. 'Total Current Assets')")
    reported_amount: float | None = Field(description="The numeric value as reported in the table (before unit scaling)")
    unit_scale: str | None = Field(description="The scale unit for the reported amount (e.g. 'thousands', 'millions', 'dollars')")
    reporting_period: str | None = Field(description="The period end date or fiscal quarter covered by the report")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    """Aggregated data from all provided financial document reports."""
    company_reports: list[CompanyAssetReport]
